column2: Retain Naas's death and Anan his son's succession over the sons of Ammon. The selected name Anan is not normalized to Hanun.
Retain reciprocal mercy, messengers sent for consolation about the father and their arrival for the same purpose. The repeated consolation clause remains rather than being treated as redundant.
Retain the rulers' skeptical first question and affirmative expectation of the second: searching the city and spying out the land. The accusations are reported speech, not narrator-confirmed motives.
Retain shaving the men and removing half their cloaks up to the fold. The half modifies cloaks here; no half-beard detail is imported.
column3: Anabole and the precise garment location require lexical review; fold is provisional and does not identify a body part.

column2: Retain the report about the disgraced men, David's meeting delegation and waiting in Jericho for beard growth before return. The reporting they need not be the shamed men themselves.

Retain David's people as those put to shame, one thousand talents of silver and hired chariots and horsemen from the three named regions. Do not replace the selected shame subject with Ammon becoming odious to David.

Retain thirty-two thousand chariots, the king of Mocha and his people, the camp opposite Maidaba and Ammon's assembly from their cities. Do not harmonize chariots into a different troop category or number.
Retain David sending Joab and the entire army of mighty men. No personal departure of David is added at this stage.
Retain Ammon's position at the city gate and the allied kings separately in the plain. The spatial distinction explains the divided fronts in the following unit.

Retain opponents in front and behind, Joab's selection from Israel's young men and the selected force arraying against the collective Syrian. The English does not add a specified number or an explicit best qualifier.
Retain the remaining people assigned to Abessa, identified as Joab's brother, and their opposing Ammon. These are a different contingent from the men facing the Syrian force.

Retain the reciprocal conditional arrangement: Abessa as Joab's deliverance against Syria, and Joab saving Abessa against Ammon. Both save/deliverance expressions remain rather than becoming an unrelated help idiom.
Retain courageous action, joint strengthening for the people and God's cities, and the Lord doing what is good in His eyes. The final future is not an explicit guarantee of victory for Joab.

Propose the Syrians fled in place of they fled. The selected Greek leaves the fleeing subject implicit after Joab and his people, but verse 15 expressly identifies the Syrians as having fled; the clarification prevents a misleading English subject carryover. All battle actions remain; the close stage preserves the inherited pronoun.
Retain Ammon seeing the Syrian flight, fleeing before both Joab and Abessa into the city, and Joab's return to Jerusalem. The selected names of both brothers are not reduced to Abessa alone.
Retain the collective Syrian's response, messengers, troops from beyond the River and Sophach before them. The selected leader is Sophach, not a parallel narrative's differently spelled name.

Retain all Israel assembled, Jordan crossing, David's approach and deployment, followed by the Syrian deployment and combat. Collective singular Syrian and plural they reflect the selected changes of number.

Retain seven thousand chariot fighters, forty thousand foot soldiers and Sophach's killing. Fighters is the inherited contextual metonymy for chariots as objects of killed; it is not an independently expressed Greek noun.
column3: The counting unit behind seven thousand chariots remains unresolved; no alternate number is substituted and no crew size is calculated.

column2: Retain Adraazar's servants recognizing defeat, covenant and service to David, and Syria's unwillingness to help Ammon again. Fallen describes military defeat here without asserting all the covenant-makers were killed.
Retain the following year and kings' going out, Joab's full-force campaign and razing Rabba while David stayed in Jerusalem. No intervening Bathsheba narrative or Joab summons is imported.

Retain Molchol their king, the crown from his head, one talent of gold, a precious stone and its placement on David's head. Neither the named figure's identity nor an inferred way of bearing the weight is silently resolved.
column3: Molchol's identity as a ruler, deity or cult image requires textual and historical review; king remains the selected title.

column2: Retain the selected violent sawing verb, saws and iron adzes, with the people as its object. Do not substitute forced labor or introduce a brick kiln. All sons of Ammon is retained rather than changed to all their cities.
Retain another war at Gazer, Sobochai the Ousathi, Saphou among the giants' sons and singular humbled him. The final object is not expanded to the entire foreign army.

Retain Ellanan son of Jair striking Leemi, explicitly Goliath's brother, and the spear-shaft comparison to a weavers' beam. Neither the brother relation nor the warrior's name is removed to harmonize another account.

Retain extraordinary size, six and six digits, the total twenty-four and descent from giants. The English does not add a detailed division between hands and feet that the selected clause leaves implicit.
Retain reproaching Israel and Jonathan son of Samaa striking him. David's brother qualifies Samaa, preserving Jonathan's relation through his father.
Retain Rapha in Geth, the explicit total four giants and their fall by David and his servants. Do not reduce four to the three encounters narrated in this chapter.
column3: The relationship denoted by belonged to Rapha and the scope of the total four require review; no missing encounter is supplied.

column2: Retain the inherited devil and standing in Israel, followed by stirring David to number Israel. The selected agency is not replaced by the Lord from a parallel account.
column3: The anarthrous diabolos can raise an adversary-versus-personal-devil question; the inherited interpretation is provisional, not a resolved identity determination.

column2: Retain David addressing both Joab and the military rulers, the south-to-north Bersabee-to-Dan sequence and bringing back the number. Report supplies the implied object of bring without an added written-document claim.
Retain the hundredfold wish, the king seeing it, all as his servants and the warning against sin for Israel. My lord refers to the king and stays ordinary human address.
Retain the king's word prevailing over Joab, travel through Israel's whole territory and return to Jerusalem. No omitted itinerary or duration is reconstructed.
Retain one million one hundred thousand sword-drawing men in Israel and four hundred eighty thousand in Judah. The figures and repeated sword qualification are not harmonized with Samuel.
column3: Inspection is inherited for episkepsis in a census context; whether muster or enumeration is preferable remains a literary and lexical question.

column2: Retain Levi and Benjamin excluded and the unusual causal clause that the king's word overpowered Joab. Do not change it to Joab detesting the order or supply a different motive.
Retain the matter appearing evil before God and His striking Israel. He is the inferred divine subject in context; the wording does not attribute the blow to Joab or David.

Retain David's great sin, the request to remove his wickedness and becoming exceedingly foolish. Beseech Thee renders the prayer's entreating force rather than a separate Greek beseech verb; Thy/Thee address God.
Retain the Lord speaking to Gad, David's seer. The seer designation is distinct from the king and the following message is mediated through him.
Retain three things raised against David, his choice of one and the Lord doing it to him. Human David receives ordinary you; no list item is omitted from the introductory number.
Retain Gad's arrival and the repeated selection command. The unfinished sentence deliberately continues into the three alternatives in verse 12.

Retain three years of famine, three months of flight and the enemies' destructive sword, or three days of the Lord's sword, death and angelic destruction. No seven-year reading is substituted and the closing request remains Gad's question about his reply.
column3: The object of the enemies' destroying sword is elliptical; the inherited formulation avoids specifying a new target.

column2: Retain all three choices pressing David hard, his future fall into the Lord's hands, abundant compassions and emphatic refusal of human hands. Do not omit the selected all three phrase.
Retain death sent by the Lord and seventy thousand Israelite men falling. Death is the selected noun; plague is a contextual interpretation elsewhere, not an alternate number or duration here.

Retain the angel sent to destroy Jerusalem, destruction already in progress, divine relenting over calamity and the command to relax his hand. Ordinary you addresses the angel; no Thou implies that the angel is God.
Retain the angel between earth and heaven, drawn sword stretched over Jerusalem and both David and the elders in sackcloth falling face down. The visual scene is not reduced to David alone.

Retain David's responsibility for the census, repeated evil-doing, innocent sheep question and the appeal for God's hand upon himself and his father's house rather than the people. Thy is direct divine address; the final Lord is retained.
Retain the communication chain angel to Gad to David, ascent and altar at Orna's floor. Do not collapse it into a direct angel-to-David command.
Retain David's ascent according to Gad's word spoken in the Lord's name. The relative refers to Gad's message and does not introduce a new command.
Retain Orna seeing the king, four sons with him, the opaque methachabin and wheat threshing. Do not replace king with angel or silently translate the borrowed form from another source.
column3: Methachabin remains untranslated and unapproved; its meaning and syntactic attachment need lexical and witness review.

column2: Retain David approaching Ornan, then Orna leaving the floor and bowing to David. The two inherited name forms reflect the selected forms and are not proof of different men.
Retain the requested site, altar purpose, worth in silver and cessation of the plague. Do not replace the stated payment medium to anticipate the gold actually paid in verse 25.

Retain the offered calves, singular plow, plural wagons for wood, grain for sacrifice and everything given. The supplied present I give conveys the offered gift without asserting a completed transfer before David's refusal.

Retain emphatic refusal, certain purchase at its worth in silver and refusal to offer Orna's property to the Lord for nothing. The selected repetition of the Lord remains; no monetary amount is added here.
Retain six hundred gold shekels by weight and at his site. No fifty-shekel silver price is substituted from another account.
column3: Whether the site phrase denotes location or the property purchased remains unresolved; the inherited at rendering does not settle that question.

column2: Retain altar building, both offering types, David's cry, the Lord answering with heavenly fire and consumption of the whole burnt offering. Divine He is contextually inferred after the human he; the source does not give fire an independent speaking role.
Retain the Lord speaking to the angel and the angel's sheathing of the sword. The pronoun subject shift is contextual; no otherwise unrecorded spoken command is invented.
Retain the temporal link between seeing that the Lord answered at Orna's floor and sacrificing there. The site-specific response remains David's reason rather than a new general ban on Gabaon.
Retain Moses' wilderness tent and burnt-offering altar then in Bama at Gabaon. The inherited Bama form remains provisional as in chapter 16.
Retain inability to go before it to seek God and hastening away from the angel's sword. Do not replace the selected haste verb with a fear verb solely from a parallel translation.
column3: The precise sense of katespeusen in this context and the antecedent of before it remain unresolved; hastened away is provisional.
